scope: Saved-native selector development comparison on 200 previously examined papers; not integrated qualification or independent source review.
metric_scope: Existing frozen references with legacy text98 and boundary checks; no mathematical notation certification or graph admission.
span_readback_scope: All emitted spans are checked. A false source_span_readback value means no final spans were emitted; held candidates may retain separately checked region spans, whose counts are reported.

skips.reason: External pinned core.py not supplied; not a passed integration gate

source_review: No independent human review is claimed; comparisons use existing attributed frozen references.
peer_review: Independent agent code and authored-fixture review, including final source-context guard; no empirical human qualification.
changed_case_definition: Differences in status, proposal, text_sha256, spans, closing_boundary or reasons; added section version and ownership metadata are not counted alone.
